sources.note: The brief specifies mm dimensions and kN load; use mm and kN.
400 mm along x, 100 mm along y (up), 100 mm along z. Tool origin at minimum corner.
Steel is stated; assume isotropic linear elasticity with E=210 GPa = 210 kN/mm^2 and Poisson ratio 0.30; grade unspecified.
Brief gives 2 mm elements; h=2 mm.
Left bearing is pinned at the bottom end edge across the full 100 mm width: x=0,y=0,z=0..100; restrain x,y,z translations.
Brief states bottom edge at right end across full width and free spanwise expansion: x=400,y=0,z=0..100, x free, y restrained. Assume a guided bearing also restrains transverse z.
Uniform total 5 kN downward (-y), on entire top face y=100 mm; force=(0,-5,0) kN.

final: DONE — Assumed isotropic steel with E = 210 GPa, ν = 0.30, and a guided right bearing restraining y and z while leaving x free.

spec.name: Bridge segment

supports.note: Pinned full-width bottom edge at x=0; fixes all translations while allowing rotation about bearing line.
Full-width bottom edge at x=400; free in span direction x. Assumed guided bearing restrains transverse z as well as vertical y.

loads.note: Total 5 kN downward uniformly distributed by the tool over the entire top surface, y=100 mm.

spec.description: Bridge deck segment; y is up. Full-width bottom-edge bearings at x=0 and x=400. Left pin fixes x,y,z; assumed guided right bearing fixes y,z and leaves x free. Total downward top-surface load 5 kN. Assumed isotropic linear-elastic steel E=210 GPa, nu=0.30. No passive regions specified or added.
